channel.title: Microsoft 365 Message Center and Roadmap Archive
channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts from message.cengizyilmaz.net. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1466864: Call Quality Dashboard Custom Detailed Reports
item.description: Call Quality Dashboard will get a refreshed interface with enhanced accessibility and features like dark mode. Public preview starts mid-August 2026; general availability begins early September 2026. No action is needed, and users can revert to the old experience during rollout.

item.title: MC1466762: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
item.description: SharePoint News can now be cross-posted to Viva Engage communities with full fidelity and synchronized conversations across platforms. Rolling out worldwide from late September to October 2026, this feature unifies content distribution and discussions, enhancing engagement without content duplication. Admins should inform users accordingly.

item.title: MC1466760: Microsoft Copilot Pages: Access existing Pages from the "/" menu in chat
item.description: Starting late August 2026, users can access existing Pages via the "/" menu in Copilot chat, while the "Edit in Pages" menu will focus on creating new Pages. This update streamlines referencing Pages without affecting existing content or permissions. No action is required.

item.title: MC1466757: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with List Form in Workflows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Workflows will add a new trigger, "A form is submitted," for automating actions based on SharePoint list–backed form responses. Rolling out September–October 2026, it enables posting responses in Teams, uses existing SharePoint governance, requires no admin action, and respects current permissions and policies.

item.title: MC1466754: Microsoft Viva Engage: Reducing reply notification volume in email
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will reduce email reply notifications by only sending alerts for direct replies, @mentions, and new posts, cutting down on broader conversation notifications. This change, rolling out from September to October 2026, requires no user action and keeps existing settings unchanged.

item.title: MC1466753: Microsoft Word: Similarity Checker retirement
item.description: Microsoft Word's Similarity Checker will be retired on October 3, 2026, and removed from Microsoft Editor. Other writing and editing features, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, remain unaffected. Organizations should review workflows, inform users, and consider alternatives if needed. No action or compliance issues are required.

item.title: MC1466751: Microsoft Teams: Lobby visibility will align with the "Who can admit from lobby" meeting option
item.description: Microsoft Teams will align lobby visibility with the "Who can admit from lobby" setting, so only users allowed to admit participants can see those waiting. This privacy-focused change rolls out globally in September 2026, requires no action, and may affect meeting workflows relying on presenter lobby visibility.

item.title: MC1466750: Microsoft Secure Score: New AI-readiness recommendations for device security
item.description: Microsoft Secure Score will add four new AI-readiness recommendations for device security in Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, focusing on TPM 2.0, VBS, HVCI, and LAPS. These will help identify and remediate devices lacking key protections, rolling out from early to late September 2026 with no action required to receive them.

item.title: RM506749: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
item.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM516043: Microsoft Edge: PDF Viewer Performance Improvement and Minor Visual Updates
item.description: The PDF Viewer in Microsoft Edge is migrating to WebUI2, enhancing responsiveness and introducing a series of subtle visual upgrades aimed at improving overall usability and utility. This migration ensures UI coherence with the rest of the browser while maintaining the same user experience.

item.title: RM561327: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: This feature is bringing the Information Protection Filer Labeler and Viewer applications to the MacOS platform. Enabling customers to have the same capabilities available on Mac. Core functionality will be available with the exception of the Advanced label-based protection feature.

item.title: RM568366: Microsoft Edge: Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites
item.description: Microsoft Edge now helps further protect users from malicious web notifications. When a notification leads users to a site that Microsoft Defender SmartScreen blocks as a scam, phishing, or malware page, Edge automatically stops that source from sending users further notifications and lets users know. Users can review and restore any of these sites anytime under edge://settings/privacy/sitePermissions/allPermissions/notifications.

item.title: RM570439: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection in Teams messaging
item.description: Microsoft Teams will provide additional protection for QR codes shared by external users in messages. Images containing QR codes from external senders will be obscured by default and require users to reveal them before viewing or scanning. This helps reduce the risk of phishing and fraud by encouraging more deliberate interaction with QR code content.

item.title: RM570443: Microsoft Edge: Tab organization enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Edge is expanding tab and Workspace organization capabilities to suggest groupings, names, visuals, and labels. Users can manage these experiences through the proposed “Let Microsoft Edge help keep your tabs organized” setting under Privacy, search, and services > Search and connected experiences; administrators can control them using the TabServicesEnabled policy.

item.title: RM570445: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to help organizations manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale. These enhancements expand support for larger SharePoint scopes, improve policy management flexibility, and provide richer visibility into auto-labeling activity.

item.title: RM570467: Microsoft Teams: Admins can control profanity filtering in meeting transcripts
item.description: Teams administrators will be able to use a meeting policy to control whether profane words are masked in live transcription and saved meeting transcripts. Filtering remains on by default. When an organizer is assigned a policy that turns filtering off, profane words can appear without masking in both the live and saved transcript, while live captions continue to follow each participant's existing profanity setting.

item.title: RM570468: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
item.description: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. A new Record only choice lets organizers automatically start recording without starting transcription. Depending on the organizer's policies, available choices can include Record and transcribe, Transcribe only, Record only, and Off. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

item.title: MC1438571: Default visibility of additional profile card properties in Microsoft 365 profile cards
item.description: Microsoft 365 will change the default visibility of 11 profile card properties to show by default when populated, starting late September 2026. Administrators can review and hide specific properties using Microsoft Graph APIs before rollout. Visibility remains manageable via admin center post-rollout.

item.title: MC1166852: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics launches new agent dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva Copilot Analytics introduces a new Agent Dashboard for tracking agent adoption and Copilot credit usage, rolling out publicly in early February 2026 and generally available by late October 2026. It offers detailed metrics, retention trends, and top agent insights, enhancing the Copilot Dashboard's Adoption tab.

item.title: MC1085133: Microsoft Teams: Rule-based enablement of Microsoft 365 third-party apps in the Teams admin center
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable rule-based management of Microsoft 365 certified third-party apps via org-wide settings in the Teams admin center, enhancing security and customization. This feature, included in update MC796790, requires no admin action before rollout and will be disabled by default.

item.title: MC1323270: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) support for Teams meetings and events
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for town halls and live events starting June 2026, offering improved reliability and backup stream failover alongside existing RTMP. No user impact; admins must enable SRT in meeting policies and update event production processes accordingly.

item.title: MC1257308: Microsoft Teams: Building‑level insights on the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: Microsoft is adding building-level insights to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal's recommended actions page, helping IT identify buildings with high Teams Rooms usage but still have BYOD rooms. This feature, enabled by default for eligible licenses, rolls out mid-June to mid-September 2026 to improve meeting consistency.

item.title: MC1466584: Dynamics 365 Contact Center- Use data masking to protect customer data
item.description: We are announcing the ability to use data masking to protect customer data in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? With this feature, customer service representatives can select individual messages from the customer and redact them, so the customer's PII isn't stored in your repository. This feature complements the existing automatic data masking rules with both automatic and manual masking. What action do I nee...

item.title: MC1466328: Frontier: [Skills] 'Explain this presentation' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Desktop)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot's "Explain this presentation" skill, rolling out in September 2026 for Windows desktop, provides users with an impartial summary of presentations, including main ideas, key takeaways, numbers, visuals, speaker notes, and open questions, enhancing understanding without requiring user action.

item.title: MC1466327: Frontier: [Skills] 'Explain this presentation' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Web)
item.description: PowerPoint for the web will roll out an "Explain this presentation" skill in September 2026, providing users with an impartial summary of slides, charts, notes, key takeaways, numbers, visuals, and open questions to help understand presentations faster. A Copilot license is required.

item.title: MC1466326: Frontier: [Skills] 'Explain this presentation' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint for Mac will roll out the "Explain this presentation" skill in September 2026, providing users with an impartial summary of slides, charts, notes, and key data to help understand presentations faster. No action is required, but a Copilot license is needed.

item.title: MC1466323: Frontier: Skills] 'Sharpen slide titles' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Desktop)
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot's "Sharpen slide titles" skill will roll out in early September 2026 for Windows desktop users, rewriting slide titles as clear takeaways to enhance impact. No admin changes are needed, but a Copilot license is required. Inform help desks and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1466321: Frontier: [Skills] 'Sharpen slide titles' built in skill in PPT Copilot (Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint for Mac will get the "Sharpen slide titles" skill in early September 2026, rewriting slide titles as clear takeaways to enhance impact. No admin changes needed, but a Copilot license is required. Inform help desks and update training materials accordingly.

item.title: MC1466322: Frontier: [Skills] 'Sharpen slide titles' built in skill in PPT Copilot (web)
item.description: PowerPoint for the web will get a new Copilot skill, "Sharpen slide titles," in early September 2026, which rewrites slide titles as clear takeaways. No admin changes are needed, but a Copilot license is required. Inform help desks and update training materials accordingly.

item.title: MC1326509: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection is introducing File Labeler and File Viewer apps for macOS, enabling sensitivity labeling and protected file viewing like on Windows. Public preview starts May 29, 2026, with general availability on November 30, 2026. Advanced label-based protection is not supported initially.

item.title: MC1466307: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce centralized channel notification settings, allowing users to manage all channel notifications from one location. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide in October 2026, preserves existing settings, requires no admin action, and aims to simplify notification management.

item.title: MC1466302: Project Online Essentials reaches End of Life on October 1, 2026: Action required
item.description: Project Online Essentials will reach end of life on October 1, 2026. Organizations must transition users to supported licenses like Project and Planner Plan 1 or Plan 3 before then to maintain access and licensing rights for Project Online, Project Server, and Planner Premium capabilities.

item.title: MC1466299: Microsoft Planner: New Planner usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center
item.description: A new Planner usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center, launching September 2026, provides admins with tenant-level and user-level Planner activity data, including active users and usage trends for basic and premium plans. It includes identifiable user info, requires no action, and supports compliance and reporting needs.

item.title: MC1466296: Microsoft Teams: Report security concerns in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a concern" feature in meetings by late 2026, allowing users to report suspicious behavior like phishing or scams. Reports, including meeting metadata, will be accessible to administrators via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center for investigation and response. This feature is enabled by default.

item.title: RM409534: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will provide native Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) controls for connected cameras that support this capability, whether the camera moves a physical lens or adjusts the image digitally. Controls are available when Teams Rooms can confirm the camera isn't independently framing the room.

item.title: RM422323: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
item.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

item.title: RM422324: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
item.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. We inadvertently marked this item as rolling out and now have updated it to be accurate. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM494839: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Scanner data export for custom reporting
item.description: Learn about the state of your scanned repositories and create custom reports with the information protection scanner. Labeling, classification and protection actions on scanned files are stored in SQL tables that form a foundation to feed into custom reports.

item.title: RM495002: Microsoft Teams: Slash commands for apps
item.description: You can now interact with your favorite apps directly from Teams chat and channels compose box using slash commands. Type / and start interacting with Apps and Agents, invoke workflows and more.

item.title: RM501120: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors
item.description: Microsoft is announcing the General Availability (GA) of federated Copilot connectors for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Federated Copilot connectors enable users to securely connect Copilot to popular third‑party sources and retrieve data in real time using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). These connectors do not store or index customer data in Microsoft services; access occurs in real time using the user’s identity, while administrators retain full governance and control through the Microsoft 365 adm...

item.title: RM529850: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Meeting Prepare from Up Next
item.description: Get timely reminders in Outlook mobile to prepare for your meetings with Copilot. The Up Next card now offers a Prepare option so you can get ready with one tap.

item.title: RM530578: Microsoft Edge: Tracking prevention when browsing InPrivate
item.description: Microsoft Edge is unifying the tracking prevention experience for non-InPrivate and InPrivate browsing windows. Microsoft Edge will use the same tracking prevention setting as a normal browsing window when in InPrivate mode.

item.title: RM545896: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
item.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning iss...

item.title: RM555235: Microsoft Teams: One-stop admin portal for Teams devices with Teams Rooms Pro Management
item.description: Admins now have a one-stop portal for inventory, health monitoring, management, and analytics for both Windows and Android devices with the Pro Management portal. Management of all Android Teams rooms, panels, and phone devices are transitioning to this portal from the Teams admin center, enabling easy, consistent, and secure management of Teams devices across all operating systems and manufacturers.

item.title: RM557559: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes. It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration. The process also involves creating a migration endpoint, running an analysis-only migration batch, using the analysis results to configure the final batch, and then starting the...

item.title: RM558679: Microsoft Teams: Standardized preview experience for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel files
item.description: Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, and Microsoft Excel files now open in a standardized preview in Teams on Android and iOS, delivering faster performance, improved reliability, and a more consistent viewing experience.

item.title: RM558852: Microsoft Teams: Digital signage support for Teams panels
item.description: Digital signage can now be displayed on idle Teams panel devices, similar to digital signage support for Microsoft Teams Rooms front of room displays. Signage source and settings can be configured in the Pro Management portal. Available with Teams Rooms Pro or Shared space-licensed spaces.

item.title: RM559608: Microsoft Teams: Quick access to read items from unread-only view
item.description: Teams chat and channel lists can be filtered to show unread items only. When this filter is applied, hovering over a section reveals an eye icon next to the section name. Selecting the eye icon opens a list of read chats or channels within that section, allowing you to open them without leaving the unread-only view.

item.title: RM559613: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
item.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

item.title: RM559617: Microsoft Purview: Purview in Microsoft Admin Center
item.description: AI and IT admins in Microsoft Admin Center can 1) gain visibility around oversharing risks and drive remediations 2) Understand how much of sensitive copilot interactions are protected and turn on Purview DLP for M365 Copilot right from there. Enables secure adoption of Copilot. Updated September 1, 2026: We are not moving forward with this change at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM560323: Microsoft Teams: Profanity filter is disabled by default for captions
item.description: We are updating the default profanity filter setting for live captions from On to Off across Teams meetings, calls, events, and Microsoft Teams Rooms (MTR) devices to improve accessibility and align with EU requirements. This change will only affect users who have never configured their live captions profanity filter preference. Users who have already set their preference will keep their current setting. As a result, some users may begin seeing unfiltered profanity in live captions by default af...

item.title: RM560820: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Increase in expansion limit for auto expanding archive beyond 1.5TB
item.description: Previously, auto expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archive beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

item.title: RM560823: Microsoft Edge: Work Search Banner for Google
item.description: When a user performs a search on google.com from a work profile, Microsoft Edge can detect whether organization-specific results are available for that query. When relevant results are found, a banner is shown with a link to explore those work results with Microsoft 365 Copilot. This builds on the existing experience already available on Bing and extends it to Google, helping users seamlessly access work-related information regardless of their search engine. Admins can control access to this fea...

item.title: RM561031: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced bookable desk experience with Teams panel-based desk dock devices
item.description: Users have better experiences in flexible work environments with Microsoft Teams panel-based desk dock devices coming later this year. The Teams panel app now enables devices, such as the Yealink Linkhub, to enhance bookable desk experiences by indicating at-a-glance availability and letting visitors book directly on the device. Each device requires a Teams Shared Space license.

item.title: RM561486: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
item.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site-specific configurations. This experience surfaces relevant actions in-context to help users restore site functionality without navigating deep into settings.

item.title: RM561604: Microsoft Teams: Chat panel open by default in the gallery view on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: The chat panel will open by default in gallery view, allowing participants in Teams Room on Android to quickly see ongoing meeting chat when they join. Admins can configure this default device behavior, and users can close the panel in one tap during meetings.

item.title: RM561648: Microsoft Teams: Town hall media optimization for VDI attendees
item.description: What’s new

item.title: RM562050: Microsoft Teams: Support human interpreter listening mode in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows now supports human interpreter listening mode in meetings where organizers enable language interpretation in Meeting options, allowing room participants to select a language and hear interpreter audio.

item.title: RM564614: Microsoft Teams: Meeting recap app
item.description: The meeting recap app brings all your meeting recaps into one place, making it easier to find, filter, and catch up. Quick filters help you surface the right meetings instantly, while audio recap lets you efficiently review multiple meetings at once. You can also browse and revisit any recap from the past 30 days.

item.title: RM564617: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Rights Management connector – Certificate-based authentication
item.description: The Microsoft Rights Management (RMS) connector is moving from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving its security posture. With this update, administrators configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate, then use the new PowerShell module to configure the certificate for each workload (Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI). New PowerShell cmdlets handle certificate import, registry configuration, private-key permissions, and validat...

item.title: RM564912: Microsoft Teams: New room optimization mode user experience in Teams desktop
item.description: Users can more easily use their laptop for meetings and collaboration in spaces like focus or huddle rooms that don’t yet have a Teams Rooms system. The new room optimization mode replaces shared display mode, has a new location, and enables or disables room-specific features. When room peripherals are connected, Teams can automatically select audio and video devices, enable speaker recognition and shared display, and disable voice isolation.

item.title: RM565131: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line Calling on Teams Mobile
item.description: Make and receive calls using multiple assigned phone numbers directly from your mobile device - choose the right line for every call, with unified call history and seamless switching across all your lines.

item.title: RM565215: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription for Teams Call Queues
item.description: Administrators can enable automatic recording and transcription for Teams call queues. When enabled, calls answered by calling representatives are automatically recorded without manual action. Admins configure the feature per queue via Teams admin center or PowerShell, with controls for recording, transcription and agent access to recordings. Recordings are stored in SharePoint and available through the Queues app call history. Note: Queues app requires a Teams Premium license.

item.description: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes. It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration. item.title: RM568372: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - SLA Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
item.description: Out-of-box MTTA/MTTD/MTTR SLA Alert Reporting dashboard showing past trends, Top SITs getting exposed via DLP alerts generated. Customers can define their custom SLAs for high, med and low severity alerts and get access to dashboard showing operational performance and SLA metrics.

item.title: RM569214: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
item.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

item.title: RM569474: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Introducing an App- and Intent-First Agent Creation Experience
item.description: Copilot Studio is evolving to an app-first agent creation experience. Makers start with the application their agent will work with and configure the capabilities it needs. This update brings tools and knowledge into a more unified experience, simplifying how agents are created and configured.

item.title: RM569609: Microsoft Teams: Report a Message or an External User for Security Concern in Gov Clouds
item.description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. Reports are surfaced in the Teams admin center, giving admins greater visibility into potentially malicious activity and enabling them to investigate and take appropriate action. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, impersonation, spam, and other messaging threats.

item.title: RM570433: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Deliver rich interactive app experiences in Copilot Studio agents
item.description: Copilot Studio agents can now render rich, interactive UI inline using MCP Apps, an extension of the Model Context Protocol. When an agent calls a UI-enabled tool from a compatible MCP server, interactive experiences like sortable tables and drilldowns render directly in the conversation. Users can now explore and act on data without leaving the chat or switching tools. A plain-text fallback keeps the agent working on surfaces that can't render the UI, and makers get this simply by connecting a...

item.title: MC1459138: Microsoft Teams: Local Pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) controls for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will add native local Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) camera controls for compatible cameras, allowing users to adjust cameras directly from the room console. Rollout begins September 2026, with no action required. Administrators should inform users and update support materials accordingly.

item.title: MC688109: Co-organizer experience updates in Teams Webinars and Townhalls
item.description: Co-organizers in Teams Webinars and Townhalls can now fully manage events, including editing details, publishing, and canceling, achieving parity with organizers. Rollout starts mid-January 2025 for targeted release and mid-June 2026 for general availability, with no preparation needed.

item.title: MC1332816: Scoped SharePoint search in Teams (SharePoint app, also called Viva Connections)
item.description: Starting late June 2026, Teams' SharePoint app (Viva Connections) search will be scoped to SharePoint content, showing relevant results and suggestions within Teams. The feature is enabled by default, respects existing permissions, requires no admin changes, and will complete rollout by mid-September 2026.

item.title: MC1324280: Assign open shifts in Microsoft Teams Shifts
item.description: Microsoft Teams Shifts introduces "Assign open shifts," enabling managers to auto-assign open shifts based on availability, time off, and scheduling rules. Rolling out worldwide from mid-June to mid-September 2026, the feature is optional and allows review before publishing. No action required from users.

item.title: MC1317836: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to send messages while files upload asynchronously in the background, improving real-time collaboration. The rollout starts early August 2026 for targeted release and mid-September 2026 for general availability, with no changes to compliance or file storage. No action is required.

item.title: MC1316231: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Webinars and structured meetings in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will default front-of-room displays to attendee view during webinars and structured meetings starting mid-June 2026, completing by mid-September. Presenters keep full control via console, no impact on remote attendees, and no configuration needed. A Teams Rooms Pro license is required.

item.title: MC1307982: Microsoft Teams Town halls: Upload custom backgrounds in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers and presenters of town hall events with Teams Premium licenses to upload custom background images in the "Manage what attendees see" feature. This rollout begins early June 2026, enhancing branded visuals behind presenters and shared content in supported layouts.

item.title: MC1250273: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve copy-paste support for @mentions and shared contacts by preserving interactive tags when valid in the destination. If invalid, tags revert to plain text with original display. Rollout occurs May to mid-September 2026 across platforms, requiring no admin action and enhancing messaging consistency.

item.title: MC1251206: Microsoft Teams: Identify external bots joining your Teams meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect and label external meeting assistant bots attempting to join meetings, giving organizers control to approve, deny, or remove them. This feature rolls out from mid-May to mid-September 2026, with admin policies to manage bot handling enabled by default for all tenants.

item.title: MC1261595: Microsoft Teams town halls now support backup Real-Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) streams
item.description: Microsoft Teams town halls will support a backup RTMP stream to improve reliability for large live events. If the primary stream fails, Teams automatically switches to the backup without affecting attendees. Rollout starts late April 2026 and completes by mid-September 2026, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1256307: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
item.description: Microsoft Teams will sync recently used emojis and reactions across all devices by mid-July to mid-September 2026, providing a consistent emoji experience. The feature is enabled by default, requires no user action, and does not affect data flow, compliance, or existing admin settings.

item.title: MC1197146: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams enables quick voice profile registration for enhanced features like speaker recognition and improved transcripts. Rolling out mid-June to mid-September 2026 for commercial tenants (excluding EDU), it is ON by default but can be managed or disabled by admins via PowerShell settings.

item.title: MC1045221: Microsoft Teams: New user setting to view incoming calls in a small window
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new default setting allowing users to view incoming calls in a small, resizable window to reduce disruptions. This feature will roll out from May 2025 to mid-September 2026 across all platforms, requiring no admin action but user notification is recommended.

item.title: MC1459131: Microsoft Teams: Prepare custom apps for private and shared channel compatibility
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out a feature by mid-September 2026 to help admins identify custom line-of-business apps needing updates for private and shared channel compatibility. Updating these apps ensures business continuity, reduces support issues, and maintains app access across evolving channel experiences.

item.title: MC1454108: Microsoft 365 Copilot app update: Simpler Copilot access
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app is updating to a unified app for personal and work accounts with clearer visual cues, a simpler name and icon, and a new web URL (copilot.cloud.microsoft). Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with no changes to security, compliance, or enterprise controls.

item.title: MC1455013: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. item.title: MC1462472: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Draft Outlook emails directly in Copilot Chat on mobile
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat on mobile will embed an Outlook email draft experience, allowing users to draft, review, and open emails in Outlook Mobile seamlessly. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide from mid-August to mid-September 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1462471: Microsoft SharePoint : Dashboard Card Visibility on Mobile
item.description: Dashboard authors can now control the visibility of individual SharePoint dashboard cards on mobile devices, enhancing mobile user experience. This feature will roll out globally from late August to early September 2026. No action is required, but authors are encouraged to optimize dashboards for mobile users.

item.title: MC1462470: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve highlighted text visibility in dark and high contrast modes for a more consistent, accessible editing experience. Rollout starts mid-September 2026, completing by early October 2026. This is a visual enhancement only; no user action is required.

item.description: Support for the Cloud Application Administrator role in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps' App Governance will retire on September 26, 2026. item.title: MC1462463: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring
item.description: Microsoft Teams admin center will launch a single pane for monitoring and troubleshooting meetings and calls organization-wide, available from late September to mid-October 2026. Admins can view in-progress and completed meetings, identify issues, use detailed diagnostics, apply filters, export data, and leverage Microsoft 365 Copilot for analysis.

item.title: MC1462460: Microsoft Entra: Domain update for My Account and identity self-service experiences
item.description: Microsoft Entra is updating its self-service identity management domain from myaccount.microsoft.com to myaccount.cloud.microsoft, consolidating related sites for a unified experience. item.title: MC1309743: Viva Engage: Email updates for frontline users without an active Exchange mailbox
item.description: Starting mid-September 2026, Viva Engage will stop sending email notifications to users without valid mailboxes, reducing email system load and improving delivery. item.description: Access to Copilot Chat on the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will be simplified by removing restrictions from the Intune policy and "Analyze content" privacy control. item.description: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager will introduce AI Powered Regulatory Templates to convert regulatory PDFs into actionable controls, aiding compliance in multi-cloud environments. Public preview starts November 2025; general availability begins October 2026. The feature is additive, requires no action to enable, and supports streamlined assessments without impacting existing workflows.

item.title: MC1266912: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard will add AI-generated intelligent summaries by late September 2026, highlighting adoption trends and usage insights for admins. The feature is on by default, requires no configuration, and includes suggested prompts. No user impact or compliance issues are expected.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce granular channel notification presets—All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute—with customizable options for mentions and threads. Rollout begins October 2026 across platforms and environments, enabled by default with no admin changes needed. No user action required; inform helpdesk and update documentation.

item.title: MC1409304: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator proactively detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Facilitator feature with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) that detects knowledge gaps in meetings, performs web searches, and posts relevant answers in the chat to improve productivity. It requires manual enabling, supports standard meetings, and includes admin controls for configuration.

item.title: MC1461157: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android will support attendee proximity join for Teams events, enabling faster connection to nearby room systems. Rollout starts October 2026, completing by mid-November. The feature activates automatically, requiring no action, and improves joining town halls, webinars, and meetings.

item.title: MC1459141: Microsoft Teams: Admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings, enhancing security. The rollout starts mid-September 2026, with default off. Admins can enable and assign this policy; no changes occur unless activated. Recommendations include piloting and communication.

item.title: MC1319216: Microsoft Teams: In‑meeting toggle to turn Meeting AI on or off
item.description: Microsoft Teams will add a toggle for licensed organizers and presenters to turn Meeting AI (Copilot and Facilitator) on or off during meetings, starting mid-September 2026. item.description: Any newly created Declarative Agents can now reliably ground answers in scanned PDFs and image-based documents referenced from SharePoint, unlocking a major class of enterprise content that was previously hard to use in agent scenarios.

item.title: RM560535: Outlook: 1-year and 2-year options for email sync window (Offline settings)
item.description: In the new Outlook for Windows, users can choose to save 1 year or 2 years of email on their device for offline access. item.title: RM568367: Outlook: Drag and Drop

item.title: RM569928: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks

item.title: RM569929: Planner: Connected Plans

item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR is enhancing the Identity page's Timeline tab to provide a unified, chronological view of identity-related activities and alerts from multiple Microsoft security sources. Rolling out mid-September to mid-October 2026, it offers improved context, filtering, and automatic updates without changing existing policies. No action is required to enable it.

item.title: MC1461704: Microsoft Defender XDR: Unified response actions across identity accounts
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR unifies identity response actions across linked accounts, enabling security teams to manage actions like disabling accounts or forcing password changes from one workflow. item.description: Microsoft Teams will personalize meeting recaps by displaying them initially in each participant's selected translation or interpretation language, with options to change languages afterward. item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow trusted external presenters (federated B2B and guest users) to manage event production controls starting early August 2026. item.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive OneDrive and SharePoint files under retention
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will add an Archive option to retention policies, allowing admins to move inactive SharePoint and OneDrive files to Microsoft 365 Archive. Archived content remains compliant and discoverable but is excluded from Copilot indexing. Rollout begins September 2026 and requires admin configuration.

item.title: MC1441775: Microsoft Whiteboard: Retirement of legacy whiteboards and transition to OneDrive-backed whiteboards
item.description: Microsoft Whiteboard is retiring legacy whiteboards and the standalone app. Migration to OneDrive-backed whiteboards must be completed by September 25, 2026. Legacy whiteboards will be deleted October 16, 2026, and the standalone app deprecated November 30, 2026. Users must migrate or export content before these dates.

item.title: MC1461529: Release Planner Retirement: D365, Power Platform, and Dataverse Move to AI at Work
item.description: Starting this fall, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse roadmap content is joining the AI at Work roadmap , giving customers a single destination to discover upcoming capabilities, track rollout progress, and plan adoption across Microsoft's business applications, productivity, and AI portfolio. item.title: MC1461528: Microsoft 365 Roadmap is becoming the AI at Work Roadmap
item.description: On August 25, 2026, Microsoft 365 Roadmap will be renamed AI at Work Roadmap, expanding to include Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Dataverse updates from September 2026. It centralizes AI-powered innovation tracking without changing access or workflows; no immediate action is required.

item.title: MC1461165: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can join channel meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow adding Facilitator to channel meetings to take notes, manage agendas, answer questions, and handle tasks. item.description: Custom templates let you create reusable, pre-designed layouts tailored to your organization’s needs, ensuring consistency and saving time. They provide flexibility to standardize content while allowing easy customization for specific scenarios.

item.title: RM558547: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
item.description: Speed up analysis of exfiltrated content by launching Data Security Investigations (DSI) from endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) alerts. In DSI, define your endpoint DLP query (for example, time range, users, and endpoints). DSI then automatically gathers the related files that triggered the alerts for review (for example, UserA downloaded a file on 3/1/2026).

item.title: RM558928: Planner: Microsoft Planner tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.

item.title: RM561922: Universal Print: Universal Print Portal
item.description: You can release your secure print jobs by scanning a QR code at any printer and access your print workflows from a browser on any device, all signed in with your Microsoft 365 account.

item.description: You will soon be able to manage multiple inbox rules at the same time. Select every rule or choose only the ones you want to update. item.title: RM569716: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook mobile apps
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on mobile devices.

item.title: RM569718: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Outlook mobile apps
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

item.title: RM569719: Outlook: Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support for Mac
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) wait-on-send policies. Organizations can require a DLP evaluation before an email is sent and configure how long users must wait for policy evaluation to complete. This helps ensure sensitive information is inspected against organizational policies before messages leave the organization while providing administrators with flexible control over the user experience.

item.title: MC1458483: OneDrive macOS Native Sync Engine
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a new Native Sync Engine for OneDrive on macOS, improving sync speed, reliability, and resource efficiency. item.title: MC1258000: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts
item.description: Microsoft Purview’s Data Security Investigations will add endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) events as a queryable source, enabling admins to analyze related files automatically. item.title: MC1461160: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in call recap in the Queues app
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding Copilot in call recap within the Queues app for recorded call queue calls, enabling users with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams Premium licenses to get summaries and ask questions about calls. item.title: MC1461158: Prepare for upcoming changes to the Excel Exchange connector
item.description: New Exchange Mail and Calendar connectors for Excel Power Query will replace the current Microsoft Exchange connector by April 2027. Workbook owners must manually migrate connections and upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office 2024. Admins should prepare users and workbooks for this transition starting now.

item.title: MC1461154: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection – Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling for SharePoint and OneDrive increases daily processing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant, enabling faster labeling of large content volumes. Rollout starts September 2026 (preview) and October 2026 (general). No action needed for current users; new users are encouraged to create and validate policies.

item.title: MC1461153: Microsoft Teams: Add multiple steps when building a workflow from scratch
item.description: Microsoft Teams Workflows will soon support multiple sequential actions in a single workflow, enabling richer automations to reduce manual tasks, consolidate processes, and improve productivity. The feature rolls out worldwide in early to mid-September 2026, requiring no admin action but user awareness updates.

item.title: MC1447678: Microsoft Exchange Online: Prepare for Exchange Web Services retirement with EWSAllowedAppIDs
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online will retire starting October 1, 2026, with full retirement by April 1, 2027. item.description: Microsoft Entra now applies system-preferred authentication to first-factor sign-ins for tenants in the Microsoft managed state, selecting the most secure registered method. item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot’s Legal agent in Word is now in Public Preview worldwide for Frontier users, expanding from the US. item.title: MC1459136: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports migrating to new domains
item.description: Microsoft 365 admin center Usage reports domains will change starting mid-August 2026, with current and new domains active in parallel for at least 30 days. Organizations must update firewall, proxy, and scripts to include new domains to avoid access issues. Redirects and domain retirements will be announced later.

item.title: MC1459133: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will support passkey registration and sign-in for B2B users to meet resource tenant MFA requirements, enhancing phishing resistance. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out from October 2026 to February 2027, requiring no admin action but recommending policy reviews to align user scopes and MFA settings.

item.title: MC1459132: Microsoft Edge: Retirement of Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG)
item.description: Microsoft Edge will retire support for Windows Information Protection (WIP) and Microsoft Defender Application Guard (MDAG) by late September 2026. Organizations using these on Windows 10 must migrate to Microsoft Purview solutions and Edge's built-in security features, as these capabilities are already removed in Windows 11 version 24H2.

item.title: MC1459130: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
item.description: Copilot in OneDrive Web enables users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license to find, understand, analyze, create, and act on files using natural language without opening each file. item.description: Microsoft is retiring 161 Microsoft 365 training modules and selected articles from Viva Learning on September 21, 2026, removing outdated content. item.title: MC1458484: Filter Messages by Events

item.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part's Content Update flow, which provided AI-generated answer suggestions, will be retired worldwide by late September 2026. item.title: MC1458477: AI overview for SharePoint News posts in the SharePoint app for Teams

item.title: RM559482: Microsoft Viva: Recent feed in Viva Engage
item.description: Introducing a new “Recent” feed in Home to give users a more predictable view of followed and priority communications, while preserving the existing personalized “For you” experience.

item.title: RM562352: Microsoft 365: Pay-as-you-go storage for OneDrive
item.description: New pay-as-you-go, consumption-based meter for additional OneDrive storage. Control which OneDrive accounts can grow beyond their licensed storage limits and give selected users more space as needed.

item.title: RM562665: Microsoft Teams: Interpreter agent support in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: The Interpreter agent acts as a translator in Microsoft Teams meetings, allowing participants to listen to the meeting in their chosen language with real-time translation so speaking different languages isn’t a barrier to effective understanding and collaboration. It's now available in Teams Rooms on Android licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM565870: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Loss Prevention to safeguard sensitive information from external web search in Microsoft 356 Copilot and Copilot Chat
item.description: We are expanding Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot to safeguard web searches containing sensitive data. This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data leakage and oversharing risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data for external web search.

item.title: RM566700: Microsoft Teams: IntelliFrame people labels in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Remote meeting participants know who is in the room and better follow the conversation with new IntelliFrame people labels that identify in-room participants and provide a hover-over contact card using voice and face profiles on intelligent cameras and in the cloud. Available with Teams Rooms on Windows licensed for Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM567301: Microsoft Teams: New controls for quick views in the chat list
item.description: The new chats and channels experience introduced quick views at the top of the chat and channels list. These are views into mentions, followed threads and more. This update allows users to choose when and how these quick views are shown. Users will have options such as always show, always hide and show only when unread. Users will also be able to collapse the quick views section.

item.title: RM567468: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage, arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios, and minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage. Users can hide the room self-preview video and choose to see audio and video participants equally on stage, instead of prioritizing video participants. Admins can choose the default behavior using local device settings and the Pro Management portal.

item.title: RM568365: Microsoft Edge: Import Google account data anytime from Settings
item.description: Microsoft Edge now lets users import their Google account data - including passwords, bookmarks, history, and autofill data - directly from Edge Settings, at any time after setup. Previously, users had no way to import this data from a Google account outside the first-run experience. With this update, the import flow is unified into a single, streamlined entry point in Settings that combines import from Google Chrome import and Google account.

item.title: RM568788: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Self-serve sync connectors
item.description: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.

item.title: RM569428: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) Writing Blocks in M365 Copilot
item.description: M365 Copilot now supports Writing blocks. Edit drafts, memos, emails, and more inline while using Chat for easy editing and iteration.

item.title: RM569435: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – In-product access to feature announcements
item.description: Viva Glint service administrators will see a new announcement icon in the product header that links directly to the Viva Glint Tech Community blog. This makes it easier to discover product news, feature announcements, and best practices.

item.title: RM569447: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

item.title: RM569606: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint – Enhanced multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options
item.description: Viva Glint administrators will be able to create multiple-choice questions with up to 500 options and upload options using a CSV file. For questions containing more than 50 options, survey takers can search and filter the available responses, making longer lists faster and easier to navigate. Reporting will support the expanded option set.

item.title: RM569717: Outlook: Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events in Outlook for Mac
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events. Organizations can detect and help prevent the sharing of sensitive information in meeting subjects, descriptions, and invite content through policy tips, user remediation, and policy enforcement. This provides consistent compliance protection across email and calendar experiences on Mac devices.

item.title: MC1419798: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Identify in-room participants with IntelliFrame people labels
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will introduce IntelliFrame people labels by mid-October 2026, automatically identifying enrolled in-room participants with name labels and contact cards for remote attendees. This feature enhances hybrid meetings, requires Teams Rooms Pro licenses, supports voice and face recognition enrollment, and can be managed via Teams meeting policies.

item.title: MC1423118: OneDrive for the web: Document library views now available in OneDrive
item.description: OneDrive for the web now lets users access, switch, create, and manage SharePoint document library views directly within OneDrive, enhancing productivity without changing data or permissions. The feature rolls out worldwide from mid-July to late August 2026 and is enabled by default. No action is required.

item.title: MC1323266: Power BI integration with Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Starting mid-June 2026, Microsoft 365 Copilot will answer questions using Power BI data for Frontier-enrolled organizations, respecting existing permissions. The feature is enabled by default, with admin controls available. Rollout spans Frontier and worldwide through early September 2026, requiring Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium and Power BI licenses.

item.title: MC1454996: Copilot Chat can float over your Outlook iPad and Mac window
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac and iPad can now be popped out into a floating, resizable window for easier multitasking. This feature, enabled by default, will roll out worldwide from late August to mid-September 2026. No action is required, but user notification is recommended.

item.title: RM484854: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Data Loss Prevention - DLP Policy Tip Support in Outlook for Mac
item.description: DLP policy tips for Microsoft Outlook for Mac provide real-time notifications to users when their email contains sensitive information that violates organizational policies. Users can see policy tips directly in the mail tip UI and have the option to remove non-compliant recipients or override the policy if necessary. This feature ensures compliance by alerting users to potential data loss risks before sending emails.

item.title: RM513278: Planner: Available in Outlook
item.description: Planner in Outlook brings all your tasks, plans, and the new Planner Agent directly into your inbox, so you can manage work where you already work.

item.title: RM533043: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updated UI for Copilot Chat entry point in Word, Excel and PowerPoint apps
item.description: We are updating the entry point user interface for Copilot Chat. The Copilot Chat entry point button will move out of the app ribbon to the app canvas to help with discoverability and use within the context of the file. This update will apply to Microsoft 365 users of Word, Excel and PowerPoint who are eligible for Copilot Chat across web, mobile and desktop.

item.title: RM547829: Microsoft 365: Enhancements to the room booking experience in the Places app
item.description: We’re enhancing the room booking experience in the Places App to align with the desk booking flow and visuals. This unifies the booking experience across rooms and desks.

item.title: RM553224: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
item.description: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics. Updated August 18, 2026: Rollout timing of this feature is now planned for end of August through early September. We apologize for any inconvenience.

item.title: RM555882: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Attach and reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot in PowerPoint using Agent Mode.
item.description: You can now reference an image when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

item.description: Download manager updates in Microsoft Teams make it easier to track file progress with improved visibility, control, and accessibility. item.title: RM566314: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
item.description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

item.title: RM569429: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Code Blocks in M365 Copilot
item.description: M365 Copilot now supports code blocks, which lets you preview code, charts, diagrams, and more directly inline while using Chat. Previously, users could preview code side-by-side in a code canvas.

item.description: Microsoft Copilot Studio is enhancing the Evaluations experience to help makers better understand agent quality and behavior. item.description: Viva Connections multi-home site management is moving from the Microsoft 365 admin center to the SharePoint admin center, consolidating administration and upgrading legacy experiences to full Home sites. item.title: MC1457838: Microsoft OneDrive: New policies to control file exclusions
item.description: Microsoft is introducing new OneDrive policies allowing users to manage their own file-level exclusions by default, while admins can restrict this via policies. item.title: MC1282683: Create and edit SharePoint pages with Copilot-powered AI
item.description: SharePoint page editors with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license can use a new AI-powered authoring panel to create and edit pages via natural language prompts, leveraging existing content. Rollout began in April 2026 but is currently paused. The feature is enabled by default and allows switching between AI and manual editing.

item.title: MC1420897: Viva Glint: Copilot-enhanced topic assignment for employee feedback comments
item.description: Microsoft Viva Glint will launch Copilot-enhanced topic assignment for employee feedback in late August 2026, adding five new topics. Organizations should review governance and update processes accordingly.

item.title: MC1261587: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Hard delete OneDrive and SharePoint files with priority cleanup workflow
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow enabling admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, even under retention or holds, with required eDiscovery approval. item.description: Missed many messages? Copilot will automatically generate a summary of the new messages in a chat conversation, so you can catch up quickly without reading every message.

item.title: RM543713: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

item.description: We're enhancing the Exchange Online Message Recall feature to add support for cross-tenant recalls. Today, you can recall messages only within your organization. Cross-tenant recall will let you recall messages sent to other organizations that add your tenant to their recall allow list.

item.title: RM565221: Microsoft Teams: Assistant field visibility in Organization view
item.description: Teams now displays assistant information in the Organization view on the profile card and in the Org Explorer, making it easier to identify a key support contact for executive coordination and scheduling. This designation is informational only and does not grant permissions, change roles, or affect organizational hierarchy.

item.title: RM566316: OneDrive: Refreshed file browsing and filtering experience in OneDrive Web
item.description: OneDrive is making it easier to find and work with files across Microsoft 365. We're refreshing the filtering experience across OneDrive Web, updating existing filters in views like Home, Shared, People, Meetings, and Favorites to support multiple filters at once, and bringing those same filtering capabilities to folder-based experiences such as My files and shared folders. Users can also filter content by file type using both filter pills and the filter pane.

item.title: RM566703: Microsoft Edge: Upgraded Copilot new tab page
item.description: Search, chat, and explore the web from one search box with Copilot-suggested actions and curated work content to help your users get things done faster on the Copilot new tab page. Users will see upgraded Copilot new tab page functionality and features.

item.description: Microsoft Outlook will support drag-and-drop rescheduling of calendar events in day and multi-day views starting late August 2026. item.description: Microsoft 365 People connectors now ingest Executive Assistant data from external HR systems like SAP SuccessFactors and Workday into Microsoft 365 profiles. It rolls out from early to mid-September 2026, is off by default, and requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

item.description: Microsoft Teams Phone will support managing multiple phone lines on the Teams mobile app starting late July 2026, completing by August end. item.title: MC1387521: Microsoft Teams: Human interpreter listening mode supported in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows with Teams Rooms Pro will support human interpreter listening mode starting July 2026, allowing participants to select and switch interpretation languages during meetings. item.title: MC999442: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management: Retention based on “last accessed” for OneDrive and SharePoint files

item.description: Copilot Notebook, a new AI-powered workspace in OneNote on Mac, will roll out worldwide from late August to early September 2026 for users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. item.title: RM561321: Microsoft Teams: SharePoint thumbnail previews
item.description: Microsoft Teams on desktop now shows rich link previews when you share SharePoint pages. Links automatically expand into a visually appealing card with a thumbnail image and page description, making it easier to understand and engage with shared SharePoint content directly in Teams.

item.title: RM562662: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App
item.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the fuller, workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

item.title: RM564805: Microsoft 365 admin center: Organizational Data – Granular access policy controls for custom attributes

item.description: This release of eDiscovery features the implementation of customer-managed key (CMK) options, allowing users to manage their own encryption keys for the data included in the direct export workflow in eDiscovery, adding to the Microsoft-managed encryption already in place.

item.title: RM566315: OneDrive: Refreshed Libraries View in OneDrive Web
item.description: We're replacing the existing More places experience in OneDrive Web with a refreshed Libraries view. Users can see more recently accessed libraries, navigate to default document libraries for Teams and favorite SharePoint sites, and use new filtering, sorting, and view options.

item.title: RM567305: Microsoft Teams: Specify who has control of production tools in Teams meetings and events
item.description: A new meeting option for Teams meetings with presenters and events that enables organizers to designate 'Who has control of production tools' during the event. Users defined here will have access to the controls in 'Manage What Attendees See' and the ‘Green Room'.

item.title: RM569215: OneDrive: Improved capabilities for files with Copilot in OneDrive Web
item.description: With improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive, you can go from files to finished work directly from chat. Copilot helps you find the right content, analyze files and data, create polished outputs like summaries, dashboards, and presentations, and collaborate by saving or sharing the results from OneDrive.

item.title: RM569363: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

item.title: RM569364: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery- Select user-owned SharePoint embedded container as a data source

item.title: RM569426: Planner: Private tasks now stored in your private plan
item.description: Private tasks created in Planner and Planner-powered experiences are stored in the user’s private plan, providing a single place for tasks visible only to that user.
